items.title: Welcome to the Queensland Reds
items.text:
Queensland’s rugby story goes back to 1882, when Queensland and New South Wales played their first interstate match. Today the Reds are Queensland’s Super Rugby team.

The Reds won Super Rugby in 2011 and the Super Rugby AU title in 2021. Club rugby in Brisbane is played for the Hospital Cup.

items.title: From the local club to Super Rugby
items.text:
Every player in the Queensland Reds squad started at a local club. Talented juniors are picked for representative age-group teams, and the best join the club’s academy.

The academy adds coaching, strength and conditioning, and support with school or work, so players are ready when their chance comes.

image.alt: The Story Bridge in Brisbane lit up at night

body.text: The Reds won Super Rugby in 2011 and the Super Rugby AU title in 2021. Club rugby in Brisbane is played for the Hospital Cup.
Home games are at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane.
1882: Queensland and New South Wales play their first interstate match. 2011: Super Rugby champions. 2021: Super Rugby AU champions.

data.headline: Match day at Suncorp Stadium: what to know
data.standfirst: Tickets, getting there and what to expect at a home game.

image.alt: A large stadium filling up before a rugby match

body.text: Home games at Suncorp Stadium are a day out for the whole family. Here is how to plan yours.
Members keep the same seat all season. Single tickets go on sale before each game, and children’s tickets are discounted.
Public transport is the easiest way to Suncorp Stadium on game day. Allow extra time: the roads around the ground are busy before kick-off.
Gates open well before kick-off, with activities for kids on the concourse. Stay after the game for signing sessions on selected dates.

data.headline: Inside the academy: from club rugby to Super Rugby
data.standfirst: How young players in Queensland find their way into the Queensland Reds squad.

image.alt: A coach holding a tactics board beside a field

body.text: Every player in the Queensland Reds squad started at a local club. The academy is the bridge between club rugby and the professional game.
Talented juniors are spotted in club and school rugby and in representative age-group teams, then invited to train with the academy.
Coaching, strength and conditioning, and support with school or work, so players are ready when their chance comes.
The same pathway leads to the club’s Super W team.
